title: Anthropic Makes Its Public Market Debut
summary: Anthropic's landmark IPO tested investor appetite for frontier AI and gave the company fresh capital for its enormous computing needs, as OpenAI weighs its own path to public markets. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow also discusses turmoil at Nvidia after Jensen Huang's departure.

title: China Plans to Strengthen AI Token Standards in Computing Push
summary: China's National Data Administration will improve standards for measuring and billing AI tokens and for quality assessment, as Beijing guides the growing AI industry.

title: The dead hand of history weighs on Deutsche Bank
summary: An FT column on Deutsche Bank argues that bankers' decisions have long-lasting consequences, with the bank's history still weighing on it.

title: CVC claims accounting manipulation in €3bn Advent pastry ingredients deal
summary: CVC alleges Advent manipulated accounts at Italian pastry-ingredients maker Irca before the €3bn sale. Advent denies that Irca's financial performance was overstated.

title: The AI cyber threat is already here
summary: The FT warns that AI-enabled cyber threats are no longer hypothetical but already here. The piece frames current incidents as only the start of a broader security challenge.

title: La caída del peso… ¿sin efecto inflacionario?
summary: El peso se depreció casi 4% entre el 18 y el 20 de noviembre hasta 19.16 por dólar, nivel no visto desde junio de 2025. El análisis evalúa si un movimiento de esta magnitud podría trasladarse a los precios al consumidor.

title: ¿Tu manera de dirigir funciona en cualquier situación?
summary: Con base en un artículo de Harvard Business Review, la columna propone desarrollar una “inteligencia del estrés”: reconocer cuándo las fortalezas habituales de liderazgo no bastan y adaptar la respuesta a cada situación.

title: Anthropic Researcher Claims to Solve Riemann Problem With Claude
summary: Following Anthropic's record IPO, a researcher at the company said he believes he used Claude to solve a famous number-theory problem that has stood for more than 150 years.

title: El peso mexicano pierde 3,5% en la semana y toca los MXN$19,19, su peor nivel desde junio de 2025
summary: El peso mexicano perdió 3.5% en la semana y tocó 19.19 por dólar, su peor nivel desde junio de 2025. La depreciación responde a expectativas sobre las tasas de Banxico y la Fed.

title: Hindlian Advisory CEO on AI & Anthropic Market Sell-off
summary: Former NYSE capital-markets head Amanda Hindlian says Anthropic's IPO should be judged separately from the week's market turmoil. The offering priced well, drew a book an estimated five to seven times oversubscribed and traded strongly on debut.

title: Scribe CEO Jennifer Smith on AI Usage in the Workplace
summary: Scribe CEO Jennifer Smith cites research putting AI use for workplace tasks below 4%, in contrast to the heavy chatbot use visible in tech circles. She discusses the gap between AI valuations and actual adoption.

title: Adjusting for Credit Risk: Masters In Business with David Eichhorn
summary: NISA CEO David Eichhorn discusses the risks and benefits of private credit, including the dangers of moving it into pension funds and 401(k)s, and liability-driven strategies for $483 billion in client assets.

title: Nvidia faces US regulator’s probe into its accounting
summary: The SEC is investigating Nvidia's accounting, adding to the chipmaker's difficulties following Jensen Huang's resignation.

title: Wall Street sufre ola de ventas: S&P 500 y Dow Jones entran en corrección y Nasdaq se desploma
summary: El S&P 500 perdió 3.7% y acumula una caída de 10% desde su máximo, entrando en corrección junto con el Dow Jones. La ola de ventas estuvo marcada por la caída de Anthropic, Nvidia y las dudas sobre la rentabilidad de la inversión en IA.

title: CrowdStrike Is in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
summary: CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler, according to people familiar with the matter, in what would be among the largest deals ever in the cybersecurity sector.

title: México oficializa control a inversiones extranjeras y abre incertidumbre por adquisiciones
summary: México oficializó un mecanismo de control sobre inversiones extranjeras, lo que abre incertidumbre sobre futuras adquisiciones. La medida es relevante para operaciones de M&A con capital extranjero en el país.

title: Cognition in Talks for $75 Billion Value With New Funding
summary: AI coding startup Cognition is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, just two months after announcing its previous round, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Las claves económicas de la semana (16 al 20 de noviembre): De minutas de la Fed y Banxico
summary: Resumen de la semana económica en México: datos de manufactura, previsiones de actividad y consumo, y las minutas de Banxico y la Fed sobre sus recientes decisiones de política monetaria.

title: Sector obrero exige alza de 15% al salario mínimo para 2027 y pide eliminar el MIR
summary: El sector obrero en la Conasami propuso un aumento de 15% al salario mínimo para 2027 y pidió eliminar el Monto Independiente de Recuperación (MIR).

title: US Credit-Fear Hits 8-Month High as Tech Angst Roils Markets
summary: Measures of perceived US credit risk hit their highest in nearly eight months, and the cost of insuring big tech firms' debt against default jumped. The wobbling AI trade sent investors into safe havens.

title: Comienzan las ofertas para comprar Axtel y su controladora
summary: Arrancó el proceso de ofertas para adquirir Axtel y su empresa controladora.

title: Hotel Tepoztlán / Taller Carlos Marín + Pasquinel Studio
summary: Located between Tepoztlán and Amatlán in Morelos, this hotel by Taller Carlos Marín and Pasquinel Studio integrates topography, landscape and views of the Tepozteco into a four-building master plan on a formerly abandoned plot.

title: Anthropic Slides 8.5% to Shrink IPO Gain as AI Trade Unravels
summary: Anthropic shares fell 8.5% on Friday, erasing part of their first-day jump after the AI lab delivered the biggest IPO in history. The slide came as the broader AI trade unraveled.

title: Wall Street Reels as AI Fears Erupt; Nasdaq 100 Near Bear Market
summary: Concerns about the AI trade erupted into a market-wide selloff on Friday: Anthropic slumped after its debut surge and Nvidia sank 14%, pushing the Nasdaq 100 to the brink of a bear market.

title: ¿En quién confiamos cuando confiamos en una IA?
summary: Expansión analiza en quién depositamos realmente nuestra confianza cuando confiamos en una inteligencia artificial.

title: Hotel Casa Zamná Tulum / Studio Arquitectos
summary: Casa Zamná is a boutique hotel by StudioArqs on a 5,160 m² beachfront plot in Tulum, blending contemporary design with traditional regional elements.

title: Mexican Studio COLECTIVO C733 Named First Recipient of the Siza Award for Public Architecture
summary: Mexico-based COLECTIVO C733 was named the inaugural recipient of the Siza Award for public architecture, created by the Serralves Foundation to recognize architectural generosity and public-space engagement.

title: Emerging Stocks Enter Bear Market as AI Triggers Global Selloff
summary: The MSCI emerging-market stock index entered a bear market after a seventh straight decline, its longest losing streak since 2024, amid the global tech selloff.

title: Anthropic soars, but it may soon be back, cap in hand
summary: The Economist argues that Anthropic's record IPO is only a start, and that the AI lab may soon need to return to investors for more capital.

title: Jensen Huang’s fall is bad news for Silicon Valley’s accelerationists
summary: The Economist argues Jensen Huang's fall is bad news for Silicon Valley's AI accelerationists, a movement already on the back foot.
